name: Aberration
description: Aberrations have a bizarre anatomy, strange abilities, an alien mindset, or any combination of the three.
mechanic: Darkvision out to 60 feet [1 BP]. Standard metabolic requirements: eats, sleeps, and breathes.
note: Alien and bizarre morphologies; foundational chassis for alien and eldritch species.

name: Beast
description: A living, nonhuman creature, usually perceived as an animal and/or non-intelligent. Beastkin are hybrids of the Beast type and have similar traits and are added to another corporeal type.
mechanic: Low-light vision [1 BP]. Beastkin are hybrids of the Beast type with similar traits added to another corporeal type. Standard metabolic requirements: eats, sleeps, and breathes.
note: Fauna, non-sapient, or animalistic beings and hybrid Beastkin chassis.

name: Dragon
description: Dragons are intelligent reptilian creatures with metaphysical abilities. Dragonkin are hybrids of the dragon type and have similar traits and are added to another corporeal type.
immunities: Magical sleep effects and paralysis effects. [3]
mechanic: Darkvision 60 feet [1 BP], Low-light vision [1 BP]. Immune to magical sleep effects and paralysis effects [3 BP]. Dragons breathe, eat, and sleep.
note: Draconic and Dragonkin chassis with innate metaphysical resonance.

name: Elemental
description: Elementalkin are hybrids of the Elemental type and have similar traits and are added to another corporeal type.
immunities: Poison, sleep effects, paralysis, and stunning. [3+3]
fortification: Not subject to critical hits or flanking. [3]
physiology: Elementals do not eat, sleep, or breathe. [3]
mechanic: Darkvision 60 ft [1 BP]. Immune to poison, sleep effects, paralysis, and stunning [6 BP]. Fortification: Not subject to critical hits or flanking [3 BP]. Physiology: Does not eat, sleep, or breathe [3 BP].
note: Primal elemental beings and Elementalkin hybrids.

name: Entity
description: A non-corporeal being which may have never been alive - such as embodiments, essence, avatars and others.
senses: Darkvision and Ether Sight out to 60 feet. [1+2]
immunities: All mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, morale effects, patterns, and phantasms) [3]; bleed damage, death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, and stunning [3]; nonlethal damage, ability drain, or energy drain; damage to physical ability scores (Con, Dex, Str); exhaustion and fatigue effects. [3]
fortification: Not subject to critical hits or flanking. [3]
incorporeal: Immune to all physical conditional effects due to their incorporeal form. [3]
planar: Not a creature of the material plane and immune to effects which would pertain to similar creatures. [3]
physiology: Entities do not eat, sleep, or breathe. [3]
mechanic: Incorporeal [3 BP]. Fortification [3 BP]. Mind-affecting immunity [3 BP]. Physical/Biological immunity [3 BP]. Metabolic/Ability score immunity [3 BP]. Darkvision & Ether Sight 60 ft [3 BP]. Planar Origin [3 BP]. Does not eat, sleep, or breathe [3 BP].
note: Incorporeal essences, avatars, embodiments, and transcendent beings.

name: Fey
description: A fey is a creature with supernatural abilities and connections to nature or to some other force or place. Feykin are hybrids of the Fey type and have similar traits and are added to another corporeal type.
mechanic: Low-light vision [1 BP]. Sleepless: does not sleep, immune to sleep effects [2 BP]. Fey breathe and eat. Feykin may be hybridized with other corporeal types.
note: Supernatural nature-connected beings, Asi lineages, and Feykin hybrids.

name: Humanoid
description: Humanoid species have no special or supernatural abilities, but most can speak and have well-developed societies. Humanoids are usually Medium but Small and Large sized varieties are known.
mechanic: Baseline chassis (0 BP). Humanoids breathe, eat, and sleep.
note: Galactic standard chassis baseline for Humans, Human variants, and bipedal civilizations.

name: Mythical
description: Beings that usually resemble beasts (or possibly other creature types), typically more intelligent and have special abilities or supernatural powers.
senses: Darkvision out to 60 feet and low-light vision. [1+1]
traits: Special abilities, supernatural powers, enhanced intelligence
physiology: Mythicals do not eat, sleep, or breathe. [3]
mechanic: Darkvision out to 60 feet and low-light vision [2 BP]. Does not eat, sleep, or breathe [3 BP]. Intelligent with special/supernatural capabilities.
note: Mythic fauna, celestial beasts, and legendary beings.

name: Ooze
description: Oozes are gelatinous / semi-solid amorphous creatures also used to describe swarms of small creatures. Many oozes use blindsight or other non-visual senses to navigate.
immunities: Immune to all physical conditional effects due to slippery/amorphous form. [3]
fortification: Not subject to critical hits or flanking. [3]
mechanic: Amorphous: Immune to all physical conditional effects due to slippery form/base components [3 BP]. Fortification: Not subject to critical hits or flanking [3 BP]. Often utilizes blindsight/non-visual senses.
note: Gelatinous, amoeboid, polymorphic, or swarm-entity species.

name: Planar
description: A Planar is at least partially composed of the essence (but not necessarily the matter) of some plane other than the Material Plane. Planar creatures may have familiar forms of other types but may or may not have abilities to match.
immunities: Immune to effects which would pertain to Material Plane creatures. [3]
planar: Not a creature of the material plane and immune to effects which would pertain to similar creatures. [3]
mechanic: Darkvision 60 feet [1 BP]. Planar Origin: Not a creature of the material plane and immune to effects which would pertain to similar creatures [3 BP]. Planars breathe, eat, and sleep.

name: Synthetic
description: Animated objects or artificially created creatures. Synthetics designed to emulate another type may have its form but may or may not have abilities to match.
immunities: Mental Immunity (charms, compulsions, morale effects, patterns, phantasms) [3]; Metabolic Immunity (ability damage, ability drain, fatigue, exhaustion, energy drain, nonlethal damage) [3]; Fortitude Immunity [3].
traits: Hardened Frame [2], Synthetic Strength [2], Repair Required [-3]
physiology: Synthetics do not breathe, eat, or sleep, unless they want to gain some beneficial effect from one of these activities. [3]
mechanic: Low-light vision [1 BP], Darkvision 60 ft [1 BP]. Mental Immunity [3 BP]. Metabolic Immunity [3 BP]. Fortitude save immunity [3 BP]. Hardened Frame (+0 Tiny, +10 Small, +20 Medium, +40 Large, +80 Huge HP) [2 BP]. Synthetic Strength (counts as +1 size for lifting/carrying/grappling) [2 BP]. Repair Required (cannot heal naturally) [-3 BP]. Physiology: Does not breathe, eat, or sleep [3 BP].
note: Constructs, androids, eidolons, mecha-forms, and artificial life.

name: Undead
description: Undead species are once-living creatures animated by spiritual or supernatural forces. Undead are based on another corporeal creature type and may or may not retain its previous traits.
immunities: Mental Immunity [3]; Physical Immunity (bleed damage, death effects, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep effects, stunning) [3]; Metabolic Immunity (nonlethal damage, ability drain, energy drain, damage to Con/Dex/Str, exhaustion, fatigue) [3]; Fortitude save immunity [3].
physiology: Undead do not breathe, eat, or sleep, unless they want to gain some beneficial effect from one of these activities. [3]
mechanic: Darkvision 60 ft [1 BP]. Mental Immunity [3 BP]. Physical Immunity [3 BP]. Metabolic Immunity [3 BP]. Fortitude Immunity [3 BP]. Negative Energy Affinity (harmed by positive, healed by negative) [2 BP]. Resurrection Limits (immune to raise dead/reincarnate) [2 BP]. Physiology: Does not breathe, eat, or sleep [3 BP].
note: Supernatural animated corpses, liches, spirits, and Deathless variants.

name: Verdant
description: This type encompasses vegetable creatures. Note that regular plants lack Wisdom and Charisma scores and are not creatures, but considered living objects. Verdant may be applied to another corporeal type for plant based creatures.
immunities: Mental Immunity [3]; Physical Immunity (paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep effects, stunning) [3].
physiology: Verdants breathe and eat, but do not sleep (unless for beneficial effects/spell regain). [2]
mechanic: Low-light vision [1 BP]. Mental Immunity [3 BP]. Physical Immunity [3 BP]. Physiology: Breathes and eats, does not sleep [2 BP]. May be hybridized with another corporeal type.
note: Vegetable, arboreal, and plant-based sentient lifeforms.
